name: nc/section-ref
title: Reusable section
description: Inserts a reusable section (nucleo_section) with its own parameter values.
aiHints: Use it when the same group of blocks repeats across pages: create the section once with params, then insert it here by slug. Read nucleo/section-list for slugs and params before creating a new section. A changed section updates every document that uses it.
